items.title: Bengals shake off slow start, take halftime lead over Titans
items.text: The Titans caught the Bengals by surprise today in Cincinnati, jumping out to a surprising 13-0 first quarter lead.

items.title: Jaguars stretch halftime lead to 28-0 on Daniel Jones pick-six
items.text: Anyone thinking the Colts would summon a Herculean effort in the wake of this week's white flag trades has been sorely disappointed by the first 30 minutes of play in Jacksonville.

items.title: Steelers rush for 160 yards in first half, lead Browns 20-6
items.text: The Steelers are running all over the Browns and have a 20–6 lead at halftime.

items.title: Cowboys lead Cardinals 14-3 at halftime
items.text: The Cardinals have had opportunities at AT&T Stadium today.

items.title: Tom Brady drops another "s" bomb live on Fox
items.text: We may never know whether the NFL fined Raiders minority owner/Fox broadcaster Tom Brady for openly and repeatedly criticizing officials during last Sunday's Packers-Lions game.

items.title: Geno Smith throws two touchdowns, Jets lead Raiders 23-14 at halftime
items.text: The Jets had the ball five times in the first half of Sunday's game against the Raiders and they picked up points on all five possessions.

items.title: DJ Wonnum carted off after friendly fire collision with Brian Branch
items.text: Two Lions collided late in the second quarter and both had to be taken off the field.

items.title: Tyler Huntley questionable to return with toe injury
items.text: The Ravens lost starting quarterback Lamar Jackson on their first offensive play.

items.title: Justin Herbert has gone eight straight starts without multiple TDs
items.text: As the 0-6 Chargers emerge from their bye with a "visit" to the Rams, quarterback Justin Herbert will be trying to reverse a horrible trend.

items.title: Buccaneers lead 9-0 as Baker Mayfield has 0 completions, Michael Penix has 3 interceptions
items.text: On a rainy, windy, sloppy day in Tampa, the Buccaneers have taken a two-possession lead without completing a pass.

items.title: DT DaVon Hamilton carted off, Jags lead 14-0
items.text: The Jaguars defense picked up the first turnover of Sunday's game against the Colts, but they lost a key member of the unit on the same play.

items.title: Jeremiyah Love questionable to return with ankle injury as Cardinals trail 14-0
items.text: Cardinals running back Jermiyah Love was injured on the final play of the first half.

items.title: Raiders score NFL's first kickoff return touchdown of 2026
items.text: The Jets moved back into the lead on a second quarter touchdown, but their edge over the Raiders did not last long.

items.title: Justin Jefferson 1-yard TD gives Vikings 7-3 lead over Lions
items.text: Justin Jefferson has made it to the end zone.

items.title: Jared Verse gets dumped by Mason McCormick on extra-point try
items.text: If Browns defensive end Jared Verse is going to whine about the Steelers being dirty, the Steelers are apparently going to give him something to whine about.

items.title: Ravens rule out Lamar Jackson with right thumb injury
items.text: Tyler Huntley has replcaed Jackson.

items.title: Titans take surprising 10-0 lead in Cincinnati
items.text: Someone forgot to tell the Titans they're supposed to be tanking.

items.title: After Deshaun Watson fumble, Rico Dowdle TD gives Steelers 7-0 lead
items.text: The Browns have had two offensive possessions and lost a fumble on both of them.

items.title: Raiders up 7-3 after Brock Bowers TD
items.text: The Jets couldn't punch the ball into the end zone on their first drive of Sunday's game against the Raiders, but their visitors from Las Vegas had more success.

items.title: Lamar Jackson hurt his right thumb on the first play
items.text: He is questionable to return.

items.title: Brian Thomas puts Jaguars up 7-0 over Colts
items.text: Jaguars head coach Liam Coen said he had confidence that wide receiver Brian Thomas would help the team make plays against the Colts in Week 8 and he was proven right in the first quarter.

items.title: Report: Vikings, 49ers had trade in place for WR Jauan Jennings, but Jennings wanted to stay
items.text: When the Vikings added receiver Odell Beckham Jr. to the practice squad, it was believed to be a message to free-agent acquisition Jauan Jennings.

items.title: Browns go for first sweep of Steelers since 1988
items.text: When the Browns visit the Steelers today, first place in the AFC North is on the line between the pair of 5-2 teams.

items.title: Jets WR Omar Cooper Jr. has two straight games with 100-plus yards and a touchdown
items.text: With all the talk about the lack of targets for highly-paid veteran receiver Garrett Wilson, the Jets have been getting plenty of production out of first-round rookie Omar Cooper Jr.

items.title: Vikings will attempt to tie franchise-record winning streak on Sunday
items.text: In 1969, the Vikings lost their first game of the regular season, at the Giants.

items.title: Jonathan Taylor is active for the Colts on Sunday
items.text: Running back Jonathan Taylor may not be a member of the Colts at this time next week, but he will be in their lineup in Jacksonville on Sunday.

items.title: George Pickens is ready to go for the Cowboys
items.text: All of the inactives for Cowboys-Cardinals and the rest of Sunday's 1 p.m. ET games.

items.title: Mike Macdonald hasn't committed to Jadarian Price playing on Monday
items.text: When the Seahawks' final injury report, issued on Saturday, had both running back Zach Charbonnet and running back Jadarian Price free from any designation for Monday night's game against the Bears, it created the impression that both will play.

items.title: Eagles reportedly won't trade Saquon Barkley
items.text: At a time when some believe the Eagles are in a soft tank, their subtle effort to secure better round-by-round draft position in 2027 won't include getting an extra draft pick or two for running back Saquon Barkley.

items.title: The new allegations against Josh Jacobs could create a credibility issue
items.text: Friday's release of police records in the Josh Jacobs case brought to light allegations made by three other women against the Packers running back.
